events.title: Demo & Release Date
events.summary: The world of Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley opens its gates!We are launching our first shop! Sort through shovels, grave stones and urns in the Cluttermancer Demo. In the full game, you can explore five different magical shops in Nightmare Alley, where you will find 6,666 items, including wands, books, potions, gravestones, and stolen coffee cups.We will enter Early Access on 30 October. You will be able to explore the first two shops in the Nightmare Alley. More shops will be added
